title: Score combination: how editor and reader scores combine (exploration)
description: Open question, no decision yet: how should editor and reader scores combine into what a publication shows and ranks by? This epic holds an exploration only. Parent initiative: PPY-77bb3b (milestone 4).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Board reconciliation 2026-10-22 (live checks 10:30-10:45Z). Still an open exploration. The live snapshot publishes both scores separately plus a default blend (ranking.editorWeight 0.5, 48-hour half-life) as a configurable parameter, not a decision. Waits for real votes.
